caseName: Adkins v. Bank of Am., N.A.
caseNameFull: Dora L. ADKINS v. BANK OF AMERICA, N.A.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until April 20, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule *173038(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
